verdict.rationale: Greptile automatically reviews every PR (greptile-docs-1). It can detect agent-authored PRs and route them to a different model for cross-checking (greptile-docs-27), and lets coding agents review their own code via the CLI or iterate until they reach a 5/5 confidence score (greptile-docs-15, greptile-docs-13). It adds runtime sandbox verification (TREX), security scanning and a parallel-agent review engine, and one hands-on user reports it catches real issues before human review (greptile-comm-13). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence specific to verifying high volumes of agent-authored PRs, and any documented throughput or scale figures for review volume.
